Decision function.description: Rein function: doc comment, a doc comment per parameter, a guard that returns, and a return

Async decision function.description: Async Rein function that asks the user with a const request
body: const ${7:solved}: boolean = await request(`${8:Instruction for the user.}`);

Parameter.description: Parameter with its own doc comment: a boolean or a union of string literals

Struct.description: Input struct: one doc comment per field. A function takes it as ({ field }: Input)

Switch statement.description: switch on a union parameter: one case per member, each returns

Template file.description: Template: one return of a template literal, with string parameters and doc comments

Reference.description: Reference to another Rein function by path, without an extension

Call a template.description: Return a call to a template reference with one named string argument
